# Jeremiah 25 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-word which came to Jeremiah concerning all the-people-of Judah, in-the-fourth year of-Jehoiakim son-of Josiah king-of Judah — it [was] the-first year of-Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon —

**2** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**5** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**6** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**7** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**8** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**9** Behold-Me sending and-taking all [the]-families-of [the]-north,' declares YHWH, 'and-to Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon My-servant, and-I-will-bring-them against this land and-against its-inhabitants and-against all these nations around, and-I-will-utterly-destroy-them and-make-them a-horror and-a-hissing and-perpetual desolations.

**10** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**11** And-all this land will-be for-a-desolation [and]-a-horror, and-these nations will-serve the-king-of Babylon seventy years.

**12** And-it-will-be when-seventy years are-fulfilled, I-will-punish the-king-of Babylon and-that nation,' declares YHWH, 'for-their-iniquity, and-the-land-of [the]-Chaldeans, and-I-will-make-it perpetual desolations.

**13** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**14** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**15** For thus says YHWH God-of Israel to-me: "Take this cup-of the-wine-of wrath from-My-hand, and-cause-to-drink-it all the-nations to-whom I send-you.

**16** And-YHWH declared concerning seventy years of captivity through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **25:1**: Opening formula for the seventy years of captivity oracle. Prophetic messenger formula with historical setting.

- **25:19**: Central imagery of cup of wrath — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic discourse on judgment and restoration.

- **25:38**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The prophetic oracle is sealed by divine authority.

— EMET
